system.description:
At 1st level, you must select one weapon group from the following:

Axe, Brawling, Club, Knife, Spear, Polearm, Sword, Flail, Hammer, Pick, Dart

While wielding a weapon from this group you gain the following benefits:

  • You add your class bonus -1 to attack and damage rolls.
  • The weapon gains the Finesse trait if wielded in one hand.
  • You are considered to have a free hand for the purpose of actions that require one (such as disarm and shove).

Automated: press Use to choose your group. With a weapon of that group your attack and damage rolls gain your class bonus − 1 (untyped, so a Combat Form's class bonuses add to it: Graham's ruling B4-2), and the weapon gains Finesse while wielded in one hand. Not automated: the free hand for Disarm and Shove, which the system does not check.
